title: VoxPopuli
description: VoxPopuli is the ultimate safeguard for your survival world. Tired of friends sneaking in commands? Every restricted command now triggers a democratic vote: the people decide its fate!
body:
# **🗳️ VoxPopuli: Democracy over Dictatorship** #

Tired of that one friend who keeps **giving themselves items** the second your back is turned? Or the one who keeps trying to **switch to Creative** mode when you specifically promised an _"honest"_ survival experience?


**We all have that player in our group.** With VoxPopuli, we’re putting an end to command-line tyranny. If someone wants to cheat, **they have to answer to the people**. No more solo decisions: either everyone agrees, or the command stays locked away!

## **How it works** ## 
The concept is simple: the plugin **intercepts restricted commands** before they are processed by the server, whether they are typed by a _player_ or executed via the _console_.

**The people's verdict:** As soon as a sensitive command is detected, all connected players are notified. Each player can vote to "**Accept**" or "**Deny**" the command.
![Remplacez ceci par une description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80e65fa17a91c7414547eec5478c226e9d47fd7d.png)

**Validation or Rejection:** 
If everyone agrees, the command is executed. However, if the majority refuses or if no consensus is reached within _2 minutes_, the command is flat-out blocked.

**Built-in intelligence:** Don't worry, the game stays fluid! Over **100 vital** server management commands _(restart, reload, etc.)_ and essential commands from over 10 popular survival plugins _(hub, shop, msg, pay, tpaccept, etc.)_ are allowed by default.

## **Protection & Security** ##
True democracy must be rock-solid. VoxPopuli includes essential **safeguards** to prevent fraud:

**Anti-Multi-Account (IP Check):** The plugin checks player IP addresses to prevent multi-accounting. It’s impossible to vote multiple times for yourself and skew the results!

**Minimum Quorum:** To prevent a player from granting themselves privileges while alone on the server, the system requires at least **2 players** to be online to validate any vote.

**Guaranteed Integrity:** Every attempt is scrutinized. If the requirements aren't met or the vote fails, the server remains locked.

## **🚨 Your last line of defense** ##
The only theoretical weakness is if a cheater maliciously deletes the plugin from the server files. **But don't worry: VoxPopuli has your back.**

Every time you log in, the plugin sends a confirmation message to ensure it is **active**. **You become the ultimate safeguard.** If you connect and don't see this message, you'll immediately know the plugin has been neutralized, giving you full control to react and counter your friends' schemes.
